rationale: SPSB is a short-term corporate bond ETF with an exceptionally compressed intraday range of only $0.05 (roughly 17 bps), volume running at 0.57x its normal pace with only ~35k shares traded, and no catalysts, news, or directional pressure of any kind. The bid-ask spread, while tight in percentage terms, is nearly equivalent to the entire day's range, leaving no viable reward-to-risk structure for either a long or short intraday position — transaction costs alone would consume any realistic profit target.
